basics.name: Matias Rios
basics.label: Tech Lead | Product & Platform Engineering
basics.summary: I have built software since 2018 and bring 5+ years in product engineering teams. At Mango, I lead engineering and product architecture across hands-on delivery, system design, and team execution. I also co-founded Geome7ric as a side venture.
basics.about:
In 2013, I pursued a degree in computer engineering, and by 2018, I had sold my first software: an inventory app for a local pet shop. Since then, I've been coding for diverse industries, including building, ecommerce, physical retail, healthcare, distribution, port logistics, and corporate transportation.

I build at Mango, a data company with financial products for the construction ecosystem in Latin America. My work focuses on the systems that power the platform: commercial credit, payment workflows and a network of 200+ points of sale. On my own time, I design and ship digital products end to end — from database architecture to payments and deployment. Previously, I led a mobile app from beta to app stores at Nuqlea and drove a key integration at Kalkomey that increased subscriptions and revenue.

When I'm not at the computer, I’m usually at the gym, playing soccer at the best friend's club of my city, or with friends and family. I also manage projects at Geome7ric, my software venture.

work.name: Mango
work.summary: I lead the technical evolution of a multi-product fintech platform, connecting business strategy, architecture, and execution. My impact has evolved from hands-on implementation across payments and integrations toward designing products, standards, and delivery mechanisms that help the team operate with greater quality, security, and predictability.
highlights: Took a collections and reconciliation product from versioned specs to production in approximately five weeks, coordinating one frontend engineer, one backend engineer, and infrastructure.
Directed the migration of 15 functional modules from Vue 2 to Next.js while preserving critical workflows and contracts with the existing backend.
Created a central engineering governance source to unify cross-repository roadmaps, ADRs, specifications, and delivery standards.
Strengthened the reliability of financial integrations through observability, health checks, traceability, and automated rollback.
Raised the security and delivery baseline through secret scanning, protected branches, and required checks across critical services.
Turned quality, observability, and technical debt into planned and measurable engineering capacity.
Coordinated cross-functional deliveries across Product, Engineering, and Data, including an operational collections intelligence surface.

work.name: Geome7ric
work.summary: Co-founded and run a side venture building products across web, mobile, and AI, including multi-tenant applications using React Native, Next.js, and Supabase.
highlights: Co-founded Geome7ric, leading product strategy, technical architecture, and client relationships.
Built and shipped multiple custom products end-to-end: AI knowledge assistants, carpooling apps, and multi-tenant platforms.
Designed and deployed production systems using Next.js, React Native (Expo), Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Mercado Pago.
Managed full project lifecycles, including budgeting, client relations, project management, and team leadership.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines, Vercel deployments, and spec-driven development workflows.
Responsible for client acquisition, requirements gathering, and ensuring successful project delivery.

work.name: Kalkomey
work.summary: Worked through RazorTech on HuntWise, a Kalkomey product, and progressed from backend execution to technical leadership across its API and CMS. Coordinated delivery with Product, Marketing, and engineering teams, and was promoted for leadership and technical contributions.
highlights: Designed and implemented an integration between Kalkomey systems that enabled more efficient subscription and revenue workflows.
Established a test suite and reusable tooling from scratch for common scenarios, improving code reliability and maintainability.
Standardized the API architecture to replace monolithic controllers and improve organization, scalability, and maintainability.
Led delivery across the API and CMS and contributed to release planning and code reviews.
Maintained solutions on AWS, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and Route 53.

work.name: Cargill
work.summary: Provided backend engineering services to Cargill through RazorTech, delivering for an international client and evolving existing integrations and services.
highlights: Delivered features and third-party API integrations within sprint commitments.
Identified bottlenecks and applied test-driven solutions to fix defects and improve performance.
Sustained code quality and delivery continuity through peer reviews and close team collaboration.

work.name: Nuqlea
work.summary: Led full-stack development of a hybrid B2C mobile application and its transition from beta to production on the App Store and Google Play, contributing to architecture, backend, and user experience.
highlights: Designed and developed mobile and backend workflows with Quasar (Vue.js), Laravel, and MySQL, contributing to the platform's architectural evolution.
Prepared the application for production by resolving performance issues and managing releases to the App Store and Google Play.
Contributed significantly to platform design and architecture, enhancing features for a B2C application.
Improved application performance and UX/UI by tackling system-wide issues and refactoring key components.
Operated effectively in an agile startup environment, consistently meeting tight deadlines and adapting to evolving requirements.
Utilized MySQL for database management and JavaScript (ES6+) for frontend and backend logic.

work.name: Indoscience / Profertil
work.summary: Completed my supervised professional practice at Indoscience S.A., providing services to Profertil S.A. I worked in a real industrial operation, administering servers and automating observability, backup, and maintenance tasks to reduce manual work and improve operational continuity.
highlights: Administered and monitored Windows Server, SQL Server, and Aspen InfoPlus.21 environments used by industrial operations.
Automated daily checks and maintenance tasks with Python, SQLPlus, and PowerShell.
Diagnosed backup, disk-capacity, antivirus, and data-collection failures, helping reduce IP.21 system interruptions.
Implemented bulk tag creation, operational displays, and historical alarm migrations.
Documented technical and operational procedures to improve support, traceability, and knowledge transfer.
